description: A dark oil painting of a muddy medieval market street. In the foreground a hooded figure in a quilted, padded jacket lies slumped on the ground beside a thatched stall with crates of bread, a dropped spear and a torn cloth near his hand. Behind him armoured riders in helmets and dark cloaks ride through half-timbered houses, with more armed men in the background. No letters or numbers, no border or frame, no blood or visible wounds, no nudity.
